title: Terlipressin vs. Off-Label Vasoconstrictors in HRS-AKI
text:
This report compares patients with hepatorenal syndrome–acute kidney injury (HRS-AKI) treated with terlipressin against a historical cohort treated with off-label vasoconstrictors (midodrine/octreotide, norepinephrine, or vasopressin).







Item
Definition




Terlipressin cohort
HARMONY multi-center registry (group = "terli")


Off-label cohort
Prior multi-center HRS registry, restricted to final_type_of_aki == 2 and hrs_vasoconstrictor == 1 (group = "hrs")


Treatment response
hrs_responders_cat_2: 1 = complete or partial response, 0 = no response


Follow-up time
time_90days — days from treatment initiation, truncated at 90


90-day status
status_90days — 0 = alive/censored, 1 = death, 2 = liver transplant (competing event)


Matching
1:1 nearest-neighbour propensity score, caliper 0.2 SD









NoteHow to read this report



All code is folded by default — use Show code on any block, or the </> Code menu at the top right to expand everything. Sections 5 and 6 contain the creatinine–response tables and the new 90-day survival analyses.

title: Terlipressin vs. Off-Label Vasoconstrictors in HRS-AKI
text:
2.1 Terlipressin cohort (HARMONY)
Variables are coerced to numeric where possible, renamed to a common schema shared with the off-label cohort, and re-coded so that categorical levels line up across the two registries.


Show code
terlipressin <- read_xlsx("/Users/to909/Desktop/Terlipressin/final_master_0508.xlsx")

terlipressin_numeric <- terlipressin  # make a copy

for (col in names(terlipressin_numeric)) {
  # Suppress warnings like "NAs introduced by coercion"
  converted <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(terlipressin_numeric[[col]]))

  # If at least one value successfully converted (not NA), keep it
  if (any(!is.na(converted))) {
    terlipressin_numeric[[col]] <- converted
  }
}

terlipressin_numeric <- terlipressin_numeric %>%
  mutate(
    group = "terli",
    death_discharge = ifelse(disposition == 5, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  rename(
    terli_resfailuretype_day2 = terli_resfailuretype_day1_day2
  ) %>%
  select(-any_of(c("fena"))) %>%
  rename(
    age_admission = age,
    sex = sex_male,
    White = race,
    hispanic_race = hispanic,
    loop_diuretic = diuretics_preadmission,
    aldosterone_antagonist = potsp_diuretic_preadmission,
    lactulose = lactulose_preadmission,
    rifaximin = rifaximin_preadmission,
    prophylactic_antibiotic = sbp_ppx_preadmission,
    nsaids = nsaid_preadmission,
    beta_blockers = nsbb_preadmission,
    albumin_amount_admission = totalalbumin_before_terli, # changed 1129
    diabetes = dm_medical_hx,
    cad = cad_medical_hx,
    htn = htn_medical_hx,
    etiology_cirrhosis = cirrhosis_etiology,
    ascites_admission = ascites_previous_comp,
    encephalopathy_admission = he_previous_comp,
    gi_bleed_admission = gibleed_hosp,
    peritonitis_admission = sbp_previous_comp,
    hcc_admission = hcc_previous_comp,
    tips_admission = tips_previous_comp,
    na_admit = na_terli_day0,
    k_admit = k_terli_day0,
    cl_admit = chloride_terli_day0,
    co2_admit = bicarb_terli_day0,
    bun_admit = bun_terli_day0,
    urine_creatinine = ua_cr_value_hrs,
    fena = fena_hrs,
    he_grade_admission = hegrade_admit,
    baseline_creatinine = baseline_scr,
    CLIF_C_Score = clif_c_score,
    aclf_grade = aclf_grade,
    liver_transplant_listed = listed_transplant,
    icu_admission = icu_admit,
    liver_transplant = transplant_lt_status,
    peak_creatinine = peakhospit_scr,
    AKI_responders = hrs_responders,
    death_in_90days_status = time_to_death_status, # checked 1129
    los = days_to_discharge,
    intubated = mv_use, # checked 1129
    discharge_disposition = disposition,
    creatinine_admission = scr_admit,
    time_90days = time_to_death_90days_cmp,
    status_90days = time_to_death_status_90days_cmp,
    MELD_baseline = admit_meld, # checked 1129
    MELD_Na_baseline = admit_meld_na, # checked 1129
    palliative_care = pall_consult # checked 1129
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # sex_male==1 -> sex==2 (male)
    sex = if_else(sex == 1, 1, 2), # updated 1129

    # race / ethnicity
    White = if_else(White == 1, 1, 0),
    hispanic_race = if_else(hispanic_race == 1, 1, 0),

    # medication use
    Loop_diuretic = if_else(loop_diuretic == 1, 1, 0),
    aldosterone_antagonist = if_else(aldosterone_antagonist == 1, 1, 0),
    lactulose = if_else(lactulose == 1, 1, 0),
    rifaximin = if_else(rifaximin == 1, 1, 0),
    prophylactic_antibiotic = if_else(prophylactic_antibiotic == 0, 0, 1),
    nsaids = if_else(nsaids == 1, 1, 0),
    beta_blockers = if_else(beta_blockers == 1, 1, 0),
    # rrt
    rrt = ifelse(rrt == 2, 0, rrt),

    # comorbidities
    diabetes = if_else(diabetes == 1, 1, 0),
    cad = if_else(cad == 1, 1, 0),
    htn = if_else(htn == 1, 1, 0),

    # cirrhosis etiology mapping (reverse of your previous)
    etiology_cirrhosis = case_when(
      etiology_cirrhosis == 1 ~ 1,
      etiology_cirrhosis == 3 ~ 2,
      etiology_cirrhosis == 2 ~ 3,
      etiology_cirrhosis %in% c(4, 5) ~ 4,
      etiology_cirrhosis == 6 ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),  # changed 1129

    # complications
    ascites_admission = if_else(ascites_admission == 1, 1, 0),
    encephalopathy_admission = if_else(encephalopathy_admission == 1, 1, 0),
    gi_bleed_admission = if_else(gi_bleed_admission == 1, 1, 0),
    peritonitis_admission = if_else(peritonitis_admission == 1, 1, 0),
    hcc_admission = if_else(hcc_admission == 1, 1, 0),
    tips_admission = if_else(tips_admission == 1, 1, 0),

    # hepatic encephalopathy grade: new(0-4) -> old(1-5)
    he_grade_admission = case_when(
      he_grade_admission == 0 ~ 1,
      he_grade_admission == 1 ~ 2,
      he_grade_admission == 2 ~ 3,
      he_grade_admission == 3 ~ 4,
      he_grade_admission == 4 ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    liver_transplant = ifelse(liver_transplant == 1 | liver_transplant == 2, 1, 0),

    discharge_disposition = case_when(
      discharge_disposition == 5 ~ 1,
      discharge_disposition == 1 ~ 2,
      discharge_disposition == 2 ~ 3,
      discharge_disposition == 3 ~ 3,
      discharge_disposition == 4 ~ 4,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    AKI_responders = case_when(
      AKI_responders == 2 ~ "complete response",
      AKI_responders == 1 ~ "partial response",
      AKI_responders == 0 ~ "no response"
    )
  )

create_first_nonzero_value <- function(data, original_variable, new_variable) {
  # Build the expected column names
  day_vars <- paste0(original_variable, "_day", 1:13)

  # Keep only those that exist in the dataset
  valid_day_vars <- day_vars[day_vars %in% names(data)]

  # Apply logic and keep only subjectid + new_variable
  data %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      !!sym(new_variable) := {
        values <- c_across(all_of(valid_day_vars))
        first_valid <- values[!is.na(values) & values != 0]
        if (length(first_valid) > 0) first_valid[1] else NA
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(subjectid, all_of(new_variable))  # keep subjectid + new var
}

var1 <- c(
  "group",
  "age_admission", "sex", "White", "hispanic_race", "loop_diuretic",
  "aldosterone_antagonist", "lactulose", "rifaximin", "prophylactic_antibiotic",
  "nsaids", "beta_blockers", "albumin_amount_admission",
  "diabetes", "cad", "htn", "etiology_cirrhosis",
  "ascites_admission", "encephalopathy_admission", "gi_bleed_admission",
  "peritonitis_admission", "hcc_admission", "tips_admission", "na_admit",
  "k_admit", "cl_admit", "co2_admit", "bun_admit", "urine_creatinine", "fena",
  "he_grade_admission", "baseline_creatinine", "CLIF_C_Score", "aclf_grade",
  "liver_transplant_listed", "icu_admission", "liver_transplant",
  "peak_creatinine", "AKI_responders",
  "creatinine_admission",
  "death_in_90days_status", "los", "discharge_disposition",
  "palliative_care", "intubated", "MELD_baseline",
  "MELD_Na_baseline", "time_90days", "status_90days", "subjectid"
)

final_terlipressin <- terlipressin_numeric %>% select(all_of(var1))
final_terlipressin <- final_terlipressin %>%
  mutate(MELD_Na_baseline = ifelse(is.na(MELD_Na_baseline),
                                   median(MELD_Na_baseline, na.rm = TRUE),
                                   MELD_Na_baseline))

order_names <- names(final_terlipressin)

  mutate(sediment_description = NA, creatinine_last_available = NA,
         rrt_crrt = NA, days_peak_cre = NA, days_last_cre = NA,
         albumin_amount_prior = NA) %>%
  select(all_of(site_vars))

Yale0913 <- read_excel("/Users/to909/Desktop/Andrew/Yale0913.xlsx") %>%
  select(all_of(site_vars))

addtional_vars <- rbind(

  MGH0913, Michigan0913, Oschner0913, Rochester0913, USC0913, Yale0913

# merge all
hrs <- merge(hrs, addtional_vars, by = "study_id", all.x = TRUE) %>%
  rename(subjectid = study_id)

# Clean variables

  mutate(
    White = ifelse(White == 1, 1, 0),
    etiology_cirrhosis = case_when(
      etiology_cirrhosis == 1 ~ 1,
      etiology_cirrhosis == 2 ~ 2,
      etiology_cirrhosis == 3 ~ 3,
      etiology_cirrhosis == 5 ~ 4,
      etiology_cirrhosis %in% c(4, 6, 7) ~ 5,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

title: Terlipressin vs. Off-Label Vasoconstrictors in HRS-AKI
text:
4.1 Matching specification
1:1 nearest-neighbour matching on the logit of a propensity score estimated from age, sex, ascites at admission, alcohol-related cirrhosis, and baseline MELD-Na, with a 0.2 SD caliper. Unmatched patients are dropped.


Show code
matched_data <- matchit(
  group_numerical ~ age_admission + sex + ascites_admission +
    etiology_cirrhosis_cat2 + MELD_Na_baseline,
  data   = all_final,
  method = "nearest",
  distance = "glm",
  ratio  = 1,
  caliper = 0.2  # common recommendation: 0.2 on PS logit SD
)

matched_data <- match.data(matched_data, drop.unmatched = TRUE)

matched_data %>%
  count(group) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = ifelse(group == "hrs", "Off-label vasoconstrictor", "Terlipressin")) %>%
  select(Cohort, `Matched patients (N)` = n) %>%
  gt() %>%
  tab_header(title = "Matched analytic cohorts") %>%
  tab_options(table.width = pct(55), heading.title.font.weight = "bold")

6.1 Survival estimates at 90 days


Show code
km_row <- function(d, label_cohort, label_resp) {
  f <- survfit(Surv(time_90days, death) ~ 1, data = d)
  s <- summary(f, times = 90, extend = TRUE)
  tibble(
    Cohort = label_cohort, Response = label_resp,
    N = nrow(d), Deaths = sum(d$death), Transplants = sum(d$transplant),
    surv = 100 * s$surv, lo = 100 * s$lower, hi = 100 * s$upper
  )
}

surv_tab <- bind_rows(
  surv_dat %>% group_split(cohort) %>%
    purrr::map_dfr(~ km_row(.x, as.character(.x$cohort[1]), "All patients")),
  surv_dat %>% group_split(cohort, response) %>%
    purrr::map_dfr(~ km_row(.x, as.character(.x$cohort[1]), as.character(.x$response[1])))
) %>%
  mutate(Response = factor(Response, levels = c("All patients", "No response", "Response"))) %>%
  arrange(Cohort, Response) %>%
  mutate(surv_ci = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)", surv, lo, hi)) %>%
  select(Cohort, Response, N, Deaths, Transplants, surv_ci)

surv_tab %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Cohort") %>%
  cols_label(Response = "Group", N = "N",

             surv_ci = "90-day survival, % (95% CI)") %>%

             subtitle = "Kaplan–Meier estimates; transplant censored") %>%

6.2 Kaplan–Meier curves

Show code
km_plot <- function(d, title) {
  survfit2(Surv(time_90days, death) ~ response, data = d) %>%
    ggsurvfit(linewidth = 0.9) +
    add_confidence_interval(alpha = 0.12) +
    add_risktable(risktable_stats = "n.risk", size = 3.2) +
    add_risktable_strata_symbol(symbol = "\U25CF", size = 11) +
    add_pvalue(location = "annotation", caption = "Log-rank {p.value}",
               x = 5, y = 0.06, hjust = 0, size = 3.6) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 90, 15), limits = c(0, 90),
                       expand = expansion(add = c(3.5, 1.5))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 1), labels = scales::percent) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("No response" = col_no_resp, "Response" = col_resp)) +
    scale_fill_manual(values  = c("No response" = col_no_resp, "Response" = col_resp)) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Days from treatment initiation", y = "Survival probability") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 12) +
    theme(legend.position = "top", legend.title = element_blank(),
          plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12))
}

6.3 Association of response with 90-day mortality
Unadjusted Cox models fitted separately within each cohort, with response as the only covariate.


Show code
cox_tab <- purrr::map_dfr(levels(surv_dat$cohort), function(cc) {
  d  <- surv_dat %>% filter(cohort == cc)
  sd <- survdiff(Surv(time_90days, death) ~ response, data = d)
  cx <- summary(coxph(Surv(time_90days, death) ~ response, data = d))
  tibble(
    Cohort = cc,
    hr  = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f–%.2f)", cx$conf.int[1], cx$conf.int[3], cx$conf.int[4]),
    p_cox = cx$coefficients[5],
    p_lr  = pchisq(sd$chisq, df = 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(across(c(p_cox, p_lr),
                ~ ifelse(.x < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", .x))))

cox_tab %>%
  gt() %>%
  cols_label(Cohort = "Cohort",
             hr = "HR for death, response vs. no response (95% CI)",
             p_cox = "Cox p", p_lr = "Log-rank p") %>%

text:
6.4 Competing-risk cumulative incidence
Liver transplant is treated as a competing event, so these estimates are the probability of dying by day 90 accounting for transplant.


Show code
ci_tab <- purrr::map_dfr(levels(surv_dat$cohort), function(cc) {
  d  <- surv_dat %>% filter(cohort == cc) %>% mutate(st = factor(status_90days))
  ci <- tidycmprsk::cuminc(Surv(time_90days, st) ~ response, data = d)
  ci %>%
    tidy(times = 90) %>%
    filter(outcome == "1") %>%
    transmute(Cohort = cc, Response = as.character(strata),
              est = sprintf("%.1f (%.1f–%.1f)",
                            100 * estimate, 100 * conf.low, 100 * conf.high),
              p_gray = ci$cmprsk$Tests["1", "pv"])
}) %>%
  mutate(p_gray = ifelse(p_gray < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.3f", p_gray))) %>%
  # Gray's test is a single test per cohort; blank the repeat so it does not read
  # as two independent p-values.
  mutate(p_gray = ifelse(duplicated(Cohort), "", p_gray))

ci_tab %>%
  gt(groupname_col = "Cohort") %>%
  cols_label(Response = "Group",
             est = "90-day cumulative incidence of death, % (95% CI)",
             p_gray = "Gray's test p") %>%
  tab_header(title = "Ninety-day cumulative incidence of death by HRS-AKI response",
             subtitle = "Liver transplant treated as a competing event") %>%
  cols_align(align = "center", columns = c(est, p_gray)) %>%
  tab_style(style = cell_text(weight = "bold"),
            locations = list(cells_column_labels(), cells_row_groups())) %>%
  tab_options(heading.title.font.weight = "bold", data_row.padding = px(4))
